_meta.what: The reader-facing vocabulary registry (#4182, ruling vii, 2026-09-26). Every builder term that reaches a reader page's MAIN content is listed here with its ruling. Consumers: tests/test_site_vocabulary_registry.py (the derivation guard + shrink-only ratchet over site/**/index.html main content) and, later, the build's inline <dfn> glosses. Charter primitives 1+2: this file owns the vocabulary; nothing else may hand-list it.

rulings.rename: the reader-facing word changes to reader_form; URLs, code identifiers and /method/* keep the term
rulings.cut: the term leaves reader pages (it may stay on /method/* and in essays)
rulings.keep-with-gloss: the term stays; its first use on every reader page carries the gloss inline (a <dfn title>)
